status: Closed — Fixed; reconciliation and receipt-scoped drain verified in source and frozen runner
area: Governed commit can land while the live index keeps parent-tree blobs
finding: A sealed-candidate governed commit can succeed and advance HEAD, then leave the shared live index holding the parent blobs of the committed paths. Modified paths stay staged against the parent tree while the worktree already matches HEAD; deleted paths remain as extra index entries (diff --cached A) after HEAD removed them. Duplicate census: ATM-BUG-2026-08-12-001 is the related index.lock / retry-queue family, not this parent-blob residue after a successful commit. ATM-BUG-2026-08-18-001 is delivery-slice admission, not live-index postcondition. The rule is commit-shaped (HEAD advanced, live index still equals the proven parent tree, worktree equals HEAD), not a task-id, actor, SHA, or date special case.
expectedBehavior: After HEAD advances, each committed path is aligned to HEAD only when the live index still equals the pre-attempt or parent-tree snapshot and the worktree equals the committed tree. Staged deletions remove the index entry via update-index --force-remove. Concurrent index change or worktree divergence is retained and fail-closed. Historical residue is recoverable through git reconcile-live-index --commit <sha> with a mandatory dry-run that mutates nothing, and a --write that applies only fully proven paths and writes an addressable live-index-reconciliation.<sha>.json receipt. Catch paths must not restore the pre-attempt index after HEAD has already advanced. git reset, git restore, stash, and whole-index rewrite remain forbidden.
evidenceOrRepro: Focused fixture: packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/implementation/live-index-reconciliation.test.ts (parent blobs remain in the live index after a candidate-index commit that already updated worktree to HEAD; foreign staged bytes survive; concurrent index and worktree divergence retain). Production observation was a successful governed commit whose live index still listed parent blobs for every modified path and retained parent blobs for every deleted path. Official recovery: node atm.dev.mjs git reconcile-live-index --commit <sha> --dry-run --json, then --write only after the dry-run proves the path set.
followUp: Repaired by the bounded reconciliation and receipt-drain implementation (including 88d4218a6). 2026-09-02 live-index-reconciliation.test.ts and live-index-drain.test.ts both passed; frozen dist contains lineage and already-aligned handling. Existing no-lineage historical receipts remain intentionally non-drainable without an explicit separate migration decision. Use reconcile-live-index dry-run then --write only for provable paths; never use reset, restore, or stash.
